summary: A module handshake accepted an id the node did not mint
details: The socket peer chose the id used for permissions and for the invocation channel. Handshake now requires an id the node minted. origin/main commit d0649ea0bba23e59b42c0c51568a6e00960f69b5. Local stability/beta-gate has it as 5a44747fd7b5117ced9b7f6903a15505fadd6525. The regression unissued_module_id_is_rejected passed on that commit. No release tag contains the fix. Reporter credit is blank pending consent. The report date was not separate from the fix commit.
